dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: All 13 reasoning spans successfully completed schema validation without errors under semantic contract v1.0 and corresponding schema definitions (rule_context_schema.json and pattern_schema.json). Complete structural compliance and adherence to defined constraints was maintained throughout.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The initial architectural context established by the rules-context-loader step effectively informed all 12 subsequent approved-adr-to-pattern synthesis spans. High-context prompt windows (over 126k tokens per pattern step) sustained strong contextual lineage and downstream architectural rationale.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: High-volume architectural decision contexts were methodically decomposed into well-bounded pattern outputs, demonstrating consistent identification of architectural constraints, dependencies, and trade-off resolutions across repeated pattern derivations.
